sect2.title: Cortar
sect2.para: The Cut command deletes the contents of the image's selections, and saves them in a clipboard so that they can later be pasted using Paste, Paste In Place, or one of the many Paste as commands. If there is no selection, the entire current layer is cut. The areas whose contents are cut are left transparent, if the layer has an alpha channel, or filled with the layer's background color, otherwise.

note.para: O comando Cortar funciona somente na camada ativa: todas as camadas acima ou abaixo da camada ativa atual são ignoradas.

listitem.para:
You can access this command from the main menu through
Edit Cut .

You can also use the keyboard shortcut
Ctrl X .
